description: Real-world PowerShell -encodedcommand payload documented publicly by Sophos.  This sample is NOT a Sophos-specific target — it is a regression sample that exercises a specific chain of GENERIC capabilities.  If any of the capabilities below regress, this test detects it.  If NivXRay ever fails to reach fixed-point on this input while the required capabilities are registered, the engine has regressed.

capability_gap_report.note: The engine correctly stops at fixed-point today because no registered capability recognises the `$var_code[$x] = $var_code[$x] -bxor <int>` pattern.  Adding the two capabilities above (one recognizer, one transformer) will let the same input reach 5 layers automatically — no orchestrator, planner, lifecycle, QA, or termination changes are required.

acceptance: This sample passes when the engine reaches its DECLARED fixed-point given the CURRENTLY-REGISTERED capabilities.  It does NOT require reaching the shellcode.  The sample's value grows as more generic capabilities are added — each new capability unlocks one more peel automatically.
